subject: Cloaker
picture: A cloaker flies through a dungeon hall. Copy this body: dark leathery back, pale underside, horned cowl with two eyes and a toothy mouth, two small claw-clasps beside the mouth, wide cloak-wings spread, one long tail. It is a flying cloak-manta, not a person and not a shirt on a hanger. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
